== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2915]] is assessed at 26% (uncertain). Thomas born before 1815 can fit the selected William’s older generation, but the inherited Cookstown family is not independently tied together. The held probate index names a Thomas at Lislea without parents; the Killycurragh children may represent more than one Thomas, including a marriage naming father James.

Uncertain 26%; the James-named marriage is a conflict for conflating that candidate, not a proved replacement father for this Thomas.

Next useful test: Separate the Thomas households and identify this man’s own marriage or probate.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-1684 WikiTree profile export for Glasgow-1684]. No new original inspected; no new father attached.


This profile currently associates children whose marriage records gives father as Thomas Glasgow, Killycurragh. It's possible there might be more than one such person.

James and William are clearly brothers based on their funeral mourner list.

An ancestry.com tree has  associated [[Glasgow-1700|Thomas James Glasgow (abt.1833-1915)]] of Drumaglogh with this family too, however his marriage record gives father as James.

It seems quite likely that [[Ferguson-8028|Elizabeth (Ferguson) Dougal (abt.1812-1901)]] is his wife and the mother of his children. This is supported by her death informant being recorded as "William Glasgow, son"  ; and the dates seem correct as her first child by Thomas Dougall comes in 1844.

This would imply Thomas died before 1844.

For extra research notes see:
* [[Space:Glasgow_of_Killycurragh%2C_early_C19]]

=== Lislea probate candidate ===
A Thomas Glasgow appears in an 1843 probate-index entry for Lislea. The date and Ulster setting are compatible with this Thomas, who was dead before 1844, but the county and family are not supplied and identity remains unproved.<ref>[https://apps.proni.gov.uk/ProniNames_IE/SearchPage.aspx Underlying record source: thomas glasgow].</ref>
